notes: Tie-down kit: a rope-linked pair of wooden wheel chocks (each ~19.6x10x9.6 cm, 10 cm apart, tall ends facing in), three ~44 cm screw-in ground anchors (eye ring ~4.7 cm, auger flight from ~27 cm down to the tip, mud-caked lower flights), three coils of orange tie-down rope (~21 cm across), an olive canvas stake bag (~25x44 cm), and a red pitot cover with streamer. The scale bar is 10 cm = ~133 px. The top chock row is a three-quarter view with the rope and is left out. The bottom chock row is read as the back view, since it shows no rope; the right-hand blocks reach x~705 px in both rows.
